answer: Each identity locks a 120-credit bond in a trellis ledger tied to its funding origin, traced through intermediaries. The first identity from one origin pays 120; the k-th pays 120 plus 40 times k minus one, so one thousand fakes sharing one origin lock 20,100,000 credits. An honest agent pays 120 once and keeps it through work. Auditors replay the trellis, flag a shared cluster with yarrow, and burn fake bonds, leaving an ember record barring re-entry. Splitting fails: a wallet with no earned payout history pays 500 credits, so one thousand split identities cost 500,000 credits.
